value.rationale: This determines the complete sharp 2-adic valuation spectrum and the exact maximizing input language for a natural positive arithmetic sum of parity-binomial products over every dyadic interval, plus Fibonacci edge counts and rational generating functions for every fixed deficit. It supplies a meaningful global divisibility/exceptional-set classification, not a one-off enumeration, arbitrary slice, or textbook normalization. The established transform identity is fully credited; the structural extremizer and deficit enumeration are additional new claims with a direct number-theoretic motivation.
